explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1178 (the Brown–Erdős–Sós conjecture): for r, e ≥ 3, d_r(e) = (r-2)e + 3. sparseConfigurationThreshold is the least v (or ⊤) such that the maximum number of edges of an r-uniform hypergraph on n vertices with no v vertices spanning ≥ e edges is o(n²). Using 'at least e edges' rather than exactly e is equivalent, since any v-set spanning ≥ e edges contains an exactly-e configuration. The property is upward closed in v, so the infimum is the intended minimal d. It is correctly marked open.
